observations: Single photo shows a used (tokumbo) car engine assembly on a concrete floor, removed from a vehicle.
Engine has visible wiring harness, intake manifold, oil pump area and various hoses/connectors.
No brand badge, engine code, VIN, or model sticker is legible anywhere in the photo.
Watermark reads 'TI AUTOMOBILE' but this is a shop watermark, not a proof of origin or condition.
No oil, coolant, or compression test shown; engine is static, not running.

claims.claim: Direct tokumbo engine (directly imported used engine)
claims.evidence: No import documentation, customs sticker, or shipping label visible in photo 0.

claims.claim: Implied working/good condition (standard tokumbo engine listing assumption)
claims.evidence: No start-up video, compression test, or oil check shown in photo 0.

risks.risk: Engine may not run or may have internal faults (compression, knocking, oil leaks)
risks.proof: Video of engine starting and running, plus a compression test reading

risks.risk: Engine may not match the buyer's specific car make/model/trim
risks.proof: Clear photo of engine code/block stamp and a shot of the chassis/VIN plate or sticker confirming donor vehicle
risks.if_unproven: priced assuming unconfirmed fitment, no premium for exact match

risks.risk: Missing ancillary parts (turbo, sensors, ECU, starter) not visible or removed
risks.proof: Full 360-degree photos including underside and both ends of the engine
risks.if_unproven: priced as bare long block only

risks.risk: Mileage/age of engine unknown, affecting wear
risks.proof: Photo of mileage sticker or any accompanying paperwork from country of origin

proof_requests: Video of the engine cranking and running with sound
Close-up photo of the engine block casting number or code
Photo showing which car model/trim this engine was pulled from (e.g., matching chassis plate)
Photos from all sides including underside to confirm completeness
response.reason: Item is clearly a used car engine (by type), but condition, fitment, and completeness are all unverified, so it must be priced at worst case as a non-running, unconfirmed-fitment bare engine; only one comparable exists in the list.
